# Learned instinct: supply-chain-build-once-promote (confidence 0.95)

Build the artifact once in CI and promote the same artifact through all environments. Never rebuild for a higher environment — rebuilding introduces environmental variation and breaks the chain of custody. The artifact must be tagged with the git commit SHA and stored in the artifact registry. Deploy by referencing the artifact by SHA-tagged name, not `latest`.

Source: SLSA Build L2; PCI DSS change control Req 6.5
